description: Explicit mapping configuration connecting detailed waste categories to primary segregation streams and physical sorting bin channels.

organic.disposal_instructions: Send to anaerobic digestion or composting facility.
organic.nuance_note: Includes food scraps, vegetable peels, garden waste. Decomposes naturally within weeks to months.

paper.disposal_instructions: Keep dry and clean; route to pulping and fiber recovery.
paper.nuance_note: Paper is technically biodegradable (cellulose), yet highly valuable as a recyclable material if unsoiled. Soiled paper should go to composting.

cardboard.disposal_instructions: Flatten and keep dry; send to cardboard repulping.
cardboard.nuance_note: Biodegradable naturally, but prioritized for industrial paper mill recycling when not contaminated with food grease.

plastic.disposal_instructions: Rinse clean and compact; sort by polymer code (PET, HDPE, PP).
plastic.nuance_note: Non-biodegradable (persists 100-500+ years). Not all plastic resin codes are economically recyclable in every municipality.

metal.disposal_instructions: Route to magnetic/eddy-current separator and smelting.
metal.nuance_note: Inorganic and non-biodegradable, but indefinitely recyclable with high energy conservation.

glass.disposal_instructions: Handle with care to prevent breakage; send to color-sorted cullet reprocessing.
glass.nuance_note: Inorganic and non-biodegradable, 100% recyclable infinitely without degradation of purity.

trash.disposal_instructions: Send to sanitary landfill or waste-to-energy incineration.
trash.nuance_note: Composite materials, ceramic, contaminated sanitary items, or non-recyclable non-biodegradable residues.

recyclable.disposal_instructions: Route to Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) for optical sorting.
recyclable.nuance_note: Used when training on Kaggle Binary dataset (Organic vs Recyclable). In the binary dataset, Recyclable represents inorganic non-biodegradable materials.

default_fallback.disposal_instructions: Retain for human review or automated secondary scanner.
default_fallback.nuance_note: Activated whenever prediction confidence falls below the safety threshold or out-of-distribution item is detected.
